verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents user-configurable Decision Center policies at the Sale checkpoint that are applied automatically to incoming orders. It also documents automatic guarantee decisions pushed out via registered webhooks. Together these are a narrow form of user-set automation that runs without manual intervention, but they are limited to fraud-decision rules, not general background automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring background jobs, agent-driven autonomous actions, detailed policy-configuration docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order.
